facts.label: U.S. adults who selected their zodiac sign
facts.method: Nationally representative sample of U.S. adults, interviewed online and weighted by YouGov.
facts.context: Respondents were offered the zodiac signs as options. This measures awareness, rather than belief or token ownership.

facts.label: U.S. adults who said they believe in astrology
facts.method: Nationally representative sample of U.S. adults, interviewed online and weighted by YouGov.
facts.context: The question asked about belief in astrology or the influence of stars and planets on people’s lives. This is not a count of investors.
